summary: Driver bypassed road barricades at County Roads 73 and 16 near Roggen and was swept away in floodwaters; the occupant was pulled from the floating car by witnesses and died despite lifesaving measures; Weld County Sheriff's Office deputies and Keenesburg officers performed six human rescues and five K-9 rescues from six submerged vehicles during the Friday flood event
responding_agency: Weld County Sheriff's Office; Keenesburg Police Department; Weld County Coroner
notes: Date pinned 2023-06-30 (Friday) from Fox Weather publication 2023-07-01 + 'responded about 9 a.m. Friday' (subagent's 2023-09-15 proposal corrected — date-pin conflict rule, dated corroboration wins); victims = 1 deceased + 6 rescued humans; 5 K-9 rescues noted separately
